claim: Services revenue growth decelerated sequentially within FY2026: +16.3% YoY in Q2 (quarter ended March 28, 2026) versus +12.1% YoY in Q3 (quarter ended June 27, 2026).
Greater China net sales grew even faster in Q2 FY2026 (+28.1% YoY, $20,497M) and 6-month (+33.4% YoY, $46,023M) than in the subsequent Q3, driven by iPhone strength and favorable renminbi.
stance_target: Greater China is a structurally weak/declining region for Apple

claim: Products gross margin percentage rose to 38.7% in Q2 FY2026 from 35.9% Q2 FY2025, attributed to mix and favorable FX, offset by unspecified 'higher costs' -- notably without the explicit memory-cost callout that appears one quarter later in the Q3 filing.
quoted_support: Products gross margin and gross margin percentage increased during the second quarter and first six months of 2026 compared to the same periods in 2025 primarily due to a different mix of products and strength in foreign currencies relative to the U.S. dollar, partially offset by higher costs.

claim: R&D expense grew 33.6% YoY to $11,419M in Q2 FY2026 while capex (property/plant additions) fell YoY to $4,344M from $6,011M, corroborating the pattern of AI investment flowing through opex rather than owned-capex buildout, consistent one quarter later in Q3.
stance_target: Apple's AI posture is deliberate capital discipline (opex/infrastructure lease-heavy), not a capex arms race
quoted_support: Research and development ("R&D") expense increased during the second quarter and first six months of 2026
